eva_csm: Heads-up — SoleraX onboarding p95 creeping to ~1.05s during daily peak. Renewal in ~28d. Thinking a low-risk plan: 10% canary to compact-slim-int8, tenant KV prefix cache, and a peak-hour routing preference to dedicated-usw. Thoughts?

dev_jun: Are they on hosted or dedicated? Do we have seq length distribution and p99?

eva_csm: Hosted. median ~110, p90 ~340, p99 ~980. Bursts align with nightly syncs every ~7m. Traces: https://redwood.app/trace/solerax/zz12

ml_zoe: For that profile compact-slim-int8 usually trims tail latency with minimal quality impact. Recommend 10% canary + run 40 golden prompts (their top user flows + edge cases). Rollback if overall quality delta >0.5% or any single prompt >1.8%.

infra_cho: I can stage a routing policy and enable tenant KV (TTL 300s). Sample policy string I'll push: name=solerax-peak-hedge window=13:00-16:00UTC preference=[dedicated-usw,hosted] canary=compact-slim-int8@10% rollback=0.5%

ops-bot: eval job queued by dev_jun (job id 9123). ETA ~35m.

dev_jun: Eval finished: compact-slim-int8 @10% -> canary p95 880ms vs baseline 1050ms. Quality delta +0.31% (within 0.5%). Two prompts show mild truncation; added a targeted post-process guard for those. No infra regressions.

eva_csm: Great. Planning canary start Thu 09:00 PT. @sam_am can you confirm comms and add a note to the renewal playbook about the latency mitigation?

sam_am: Confirmed — I'll notify the customer, schedule the window, and add the renewal playbook entry.

infra_cho: Routing policy and KV toggle staged; monitoring alarms set for p95, error-rate, and the eval quality metric. Auto-rollback enabled if threshold exceeded.

eva_csm: Thanks all — I'll collect customer feedback during the canary and post results here. :thumbsup:
